Messages.Author: Jean-François Caron
Messages.Body:
Hello.

I know this matter must already have been adressed, but i can't keep
myself from asking, since the answer i found on dejanews does not
satisfy me.

So, if I play a gangrel-nosferatu deck, and I have in hand the Zoo
Hunting Ground, wich of the following options would happen:

1- I will only be able to bring out the Zoo when i'll have a ready
gangrel and the blood collected in the blood bank will go either to a
gangrel OR a nosferatu.

or

2- I will be able to bring out the Zoo whenever I want, but the blood
taken from the blodd bank during my untap will go only to a Gangrel.

or

3- Anything else ?!?

Thanks

Jean-François Caron

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 15 Mar 2000, Jean-François Caron wrote:
> So, if I play a gangrel-nosferatu deck, and I have in hand the Zoo
> Hunting Ground, wich of the following options would happen:

Zoo Hunting Ground requires a ready Gangrel to play. So you must have,
say, Chandler Hungerford ready (or any other Gangrel) to play it.

Once it is in play, it doesn't matter who uses it. the card gives blood
to a vampire, not to a Gangrel, so any vampire can benefit from it. Also,
it doesn't matter if you end up at some point only controlling Nosferatu
(once it's in play, say you use a Clan Impersonation or have your vampire
burned) - it only needs the Gangrel to *play* it.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>I know this matter must already have been adressed, but i can't keep
>myself from asking, since the answer i found on dejanews does not
>satisfy me.
>

Master cards that have a clan symbol means that you must control a ready member
of that clan in order to use it. Thus you need a ready Gangrel to bring out Zoo
Hunting Grounds, a ready Brujah to play Carthage Remembered, and a ready
Ventrue to play Hostile Takeover.

For Minion cards that have a clan symbol, a minion of that clan is needed to
perform the action. Thus only Setites can play Corruption and only Assamites
can equip with Kali's Fang (though other vampires could later gain control of
it).

And for Hunting Grounds, ANY ready vampire you control can gain the blood,
regardless of clan. So overall, your Option #1 was correct.

Halcyan 2
